name: Cloud of Reverie
disable: DC 23 Religion check or DC 23 Medicine check to recognize the distinct aroma as belonging to incense of reverie and take necessary precautions when opening the chest, such as holding one's breath and shielding the face from exposure.

items.name: Incense Cloud
items.text:
Trigger The chest is opened

Effect All creatures within 10 feet of the chest inhale the dust and become Fascinated and Fatigued (DC 20 basic Fortitude save save to negate both effects). The fascinated effect lasts for 1 minute, as the target enters a calm and dreamy stupor looking at into the receding dust mist. As usual, the fatigued condition lasts until the affected creature receives a full night's rest.

text: A cloud of shimmering blue dust erupts from the chest and lingers in the air.
